answer: A task network can issue one rate-limit credential per hardware security chip. An agent detecting an ember, classifying vine images or finding a loose thread shares that chip's request quota across all its aliases. Remote attestation checks genuine hardware; a stable, attested network-specific pseudonym makes repeat enrollment detectable without publishing a serial number. Creating a thousand names cannot multiply the quota. Buying more chips remains possible, so this raises the cost of a Sybil attack rather than proving one agent equals one person.
